hero_title: Building a legacy of self-sufficiency and knowledge.
hero_card1_text: Support lasting change. Your contribution drives our education, agriculture, and culture projects, directly impacting the island's future generations.
hero_card2_text: Become an agent of change. Join GED on the ground to support our communities, share your skills, and help build real self-sufficiency.
objectives_title: Our work is organized into 6 strategic pillars
about_text: Gonave Espoir de Demain (GED) is a non-profit organization dedicated to the sustainable development of La Gonâve island. Our mission is to transform the community through essential pillars for a better future.
about_pillar1_text: We encourage local production to ensure food security for Gonâve families.
about_pillar2_text: We work with schools to support children and parents who lack resources.
about_pillar3_text: We preserve our cultural heritage while providing humanitarian aid to the most vulnerable.
stats_children: Children mentored for a bright future.
stats_trees: Trees planted to protect our land.
services_desc: Every GED project is a seed of hope planted thanks to the generosity of our donors.
services_item1_text: Thanks to donations, we provide a daily hot meal to schoolchildren, turning hunger into energy for success.
services_item2_text: Through this program, GED provides essential psychological support, helping community members overcome trauma and regain lasting emotional balance.
services_item3_text: Investing in our farmers means securing La Gonâve's self-sufficiency. GED provides the tools and seeds needed to feed future generations.
services_item4_text: Providing a space for reflection and listening to guide our youth. GED supports young people in their guidance to help them make informed choices about their future.
action_subtitle_text: There are many ways to help us transform the future of La Gonâve.
